day_line: A raw blade on a Rat day. Sharp and quick: good for clear plans and fresh starts, easy to sound too blunt.

lines.Yang Wood: Sunday feels a bit tight today. Say no to one plan and keep the evening free.
lines.Yin Wood: Someone sees your effort today. Accept the thank-you; don't say 'it's nothing'.
lines.Yang Fire: A good chance turns up today. Say yes to the invite, then check the time.
lines.Yin Fire: Simple spending wins today. Cook at home and plan next week's meals.
lines.Yang Earth: You're easy company today. Host a small lunch; buy the dessert, don't bake it.
lines.Yin Earth: Your advice is sharp today. Offer it once; let the family decide.
lines.Yang Metal: Your crew is close today. Meet for a walk by the water; kopi after.
lines.Yin Metal: Someone wants the same plan today. Take turns choosing; you go next week.
lines.Yang Water: A fresh thought comes today. Leave the phone in the bag and let it grow.
lines.Yin Water: Someone spoils you a little today. Let them, and nap if you can.
